Live Text engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume text-recognition capability covers storefront language. Xcode, entitlements, and Connect actually separate OCR behavior from product-page copy:

  • Vision framework & VNRecognizeTextRequest — in-app code that detects and recognizes text in images or camera frames. Controls what text your app can read. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • DataScannerViewController & Live Text APIs — engineering work for live camera text scanning, text-selection overlays, and on-device OCR pipelines. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains text-extraction value to buyers.
  • Photo import vs text extraction — your binary may import photos from the library, scan text in the viewfinder, or both. Listing copy should match what screenshots actually show — not promise Live Text when the gallery only shows a generic photo picker.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of OCR integration.

Working text-recognition flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Live Text and text-from-photo workflows on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement Vision or Live Text APIs.

Listing copy should name the correct one per frame — a text-selection highlight on a receipt photo is not a Take Photo shutter button, not a Choose Photos sheet, not a Copy to clipboard toolbar action, and not a Spotlight search results screen.

Text-extraction apps often lead marketing screenshots with Live Text selection handles, Copy text callouts on photos, camera viewfinder text overlays, or Extract text confirmation sheets — surfaces where English marketing text appears beside system text-recognition chrome:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese text-extraction positioning

  • Text-extraction value in English — description opens with US marketing ("Copy any text from photos instantly") that China readers skim past or misread
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 实况文本, 复制文字, 扫描文字, or 图片文字识别; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent
  • Mixed page — Chinese description pasted once but screenshot captions and subtitle still English — reads unfinished next to localized competitors
  • Conflating Live Text with Camera or Photos picker — machine translation that promises 拍照 or 从相册选择 when your app only extracts text from existing images — mismatched expectations at install

Common mistakes on Live Text-themed zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming OCR integration localizes automatically — Vision or Live Text shipped in the binary; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Live Text screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating Live Text with Camera capture — listing says 拍照 when the app only extracts text from imported photos, not live shutter capture
  • Conflating Live Text with Photos picker — Choose Photos belongs on the Photos picker listing guide, not text-selection frames
  • Conflating Live Text with Clipboard — Universal Clipboard belongs on the Clipboard listing guide, not photo OCR screenshots
  • English Copy text on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in selection labels on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement Vision or DataScannerViewController — OCR pipelines and text-selection UI are engineering tasks outside listing rewrite scope
  • What's New still English after Live Text launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when text-from-photo support shipped in a recent version
